lines.t: Verse 1
Miciah, your smile is like the sun,
Shining down a beautiful rose beginning to bloom.
Joseph, your eyes are like a beautiful emerald,
Glowing with the light of God.
Chorus
Oh, my grand children, my grand children,
Treasures of my heart in the Father’s hand.
Oh, my grand children, my grand children,
Held forever in His love, by His perfect plan.
Verse 2
Joshua, your face reveals the image of YahuShuah,
Wrapping His arms around you with His love.
Evelyn, your beauty is like a pearl of great price,
Shining brightly with God’s glory above.
Chorus
Oh, my grand children, my grand children,
Treasures of my heart in the Father’s hand.
Oh, my grand children, my grand children,
Held forever in His love, by His perfect plan.
Bridge / Tag
And now my precious grand kids, your having two more twins,
Like a chicken hatching her eggs, these little ones will be born,
God’s strength in their legs, God’s strength in their legs,
My grand children, my grand children.
